title: ASCenD-BDS: Adaptable, Stochastic and Context-aware framework for Detection of Bias, Discrimination and Stereotyping
benchmark_measurement: Detection of bias, discrimination, and stereotyping related to religion within a context-aware framework (specifically Indian context).
base_benchmarks: BOLD (Bias in Open-ended Language Generation) Dataset
BBQ: A Hand-Built Bias Benchmark for Question Answering
findings: The paper proposes a framework, ASCenD-BDS, which includes 'Religion' as one of its 10 core categories for detecting bias, discrimination, and stereotyping in LLMs. The framework is designed to be adaptable and context-aware, with a specific focus on the Indian sociocultural landscape, but does not present empirical findings on religious bias in any specific model.
